title: First trip to Japan with Teddy Wilson, Milt Hinton and Shelly Manne
summary: She went to Japan in August 1980 with a group including Benny Goodman, Teddy Wilson, Milt Hinton, Shelly Manne and Lockjaw. Audiences went crazy, Shirley Silver carried her bags, and she did three concerts in eight days.
